messages:
hazel: Heads-up — CI started failing on the LlamaIndex Next starter's evals. The nightly run timed out and we saw huge retry/backoff churn in the SDK logs.
omar: which branch + SDK pinned?
hazel: devex-starters/next-llama-index main, requirements pin shows redwood-py==0.8.2. Evals in eng-ml/nightly run a streaming summarization with batch_size=8 and expected runtime ~90s. CI hung around 6m due to repeated retries.
lucy: do you have sanitized logs?
hazel: logs: [2026-01-12T04:10:01Z] POST /v1/stream 200 stream-start
[2026-01-12T04:11:05Z] STREAM ERROR: 500 transient server error
[2026-01-12T04:11:05Z] SDK RETRY attempt=1 backoff=2s
[2026-01-12T04:11:07Z] POST /v1/stream 200 stream-start
[2026-01-12T04:12:10Z] STREAM ERROR: 500
[2026-01-12T04:12:10Z] SDK RETRY attempt=2 backoff=8s
[2026-01-12T04:12:18Z] POST /v1/stream 429 Too Many Requests
... repeats until CI timeout
lucy: looks like the SDK's exponential backoff doubled into long waits. For CI we should prefer a shorter retry policy or non-retry on streaming evals to keep run-time predictable.
hazel: agreed. The starter's eval harness spawns multiple parallel agents which amplified the retries and caused quota throttling. CI capacity is limited so we need deterministic behavior.
omar: short-term fix: update the eval config to set REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_MODE=none for nightly runs and add a wrapper that treats stream errors as immediate failures in the harness. Also bump the starter README to recommend smaller batch_size for CI. I'll open a PR.
lucy: long-term: SDK should expose a per-call policy for streaming: { retries: 0|n, max_backoff_s, jitter } and a named preset `ci_fast_fail` so we can standardize across repos. Also add an env var override so CI pipelines can opt into it without code changes.
sdk-bot: ISSUE-2016 created to add per-call streaming retry policy and a `ci_fast_fail` preset. Assigned to @omar.
eng-qa: for stability we should also add an eval harness test that intentionally injects 500s at t=30s and asserts the harness fails fast when `REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_MODE=none`. That will prevent accidental revert. I'll add that to eng-ml/nightly.
omar: PR 404 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-starters/pull/404 — includes: README note about CI sizing, reduced eval batch_size=2 for nightly, test wrapper that sets REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_MODE=none in CI, and an assertion to fail fast on stream errors.
hazel: pulled PR and re-ran the nightly locally. With retry_mode=none the run now fails fast and CI completes within expected window; we avoid the quota storms. UX for dev notebooks remains unchanged.
lucy: next steps: SDK owners implement the per-call policy and env override, eng-ml add the failing-fast eval, and docs team update onboarding notes about recommended settings for "local/dev", "workshop", and "CI/nightly" profiles.
omar: noted. I'll start the SDK change and wire a telemetry counter `stream_retries_suppressed_ci`.
sdk-bot: linked ISSUE-2016 to PR 404 for tracking.
hazel: thanks team — this should make our nightly evals much more predictable and reduce flakiness. I'll also add a short blurb in the starter README that explains why CI uses a different retry policy.
eng-qa: adding the harness now. Will ping when nightly passes with the new setting.
